title: Accessibility Statement | House of Zen
description: Everyone deserves to use this site comfortably. Here is what the House of Zen site is built to do, and how to tell us about a barrier by phone or by email.
lede: Everyone deserves to use this site comfortably.

sections.heading: What this site is built to do

items: Keyboard navigation: you can move through the site with a keyboard.
Text alternatives: images that carry meaning have a text alternative.
Reduced motion: if your device asks for reduced motion, the site respects it.

blocks.html: That is the honest list. We make no claim that every page works perfectly for every person, and we would rather hear about a problem than assume there is none.
If something on this site gets in your way, please tell us which page you were on and what happened. You can call us at (313) 332-1733 or email hello@houseofzendetroit.com.

_confirm: For counsel: review this statement before it goes live. It makes no conformance claim and names no standard, on purpose. Adding a named standard or an audit date is a decision for the owners and counsel.
For the owners: the phone and email here are the store's general contacts. Confirm they are the right place for accessibility reports.
